description: v2.0 stage 2 D4 (defect D-07): every fee a simulation charges comes from a schedule here with an as_of date, a label (quoted = copied from a published price list on that date with its URL; indicative = a representative figure not quoted from a list; assumed = a planning value) and a source. iap.execution.fees.load_fee_schedule refuses a schedule without a valid as_of, label or source. The engine's three cost columns (iap.execution.sim) read engine_default. Regulatory fees (SEC Section 31, FINRA TAF) are in configs/reference/regulatory_fee_schedule.json, dated per period.

engine_default.label: assumed
engine_default.source: E0 section 9 planning value (EN4, PR #385): one all-in per-share fee for the executable ledger; to be replaced by a quoted schedule before any economic verdict (D-15)

xnas_access_fee_cap.label: indicative
xnas_access_fee_cap.source: configs/reference/fee_tiers.json 'top' (v1.16 P0-3): taker at the Reg NMS Rule 610(c) access-fee cap of $0.0030 per share, rebate a representative top-tier figure; not a quoted Nasdaq price list

synthetic_venue_xv1.label: assumed
synthetic_venue_xv1.source: configs/venues/venues.json XV1 (the synthetic venue default; research/execution/venue_model.json first tier)
